verdict.rationale: Typesense has a static, versioned API reference (e.g. the /docs/latest/api/curation page with a "Copy Markdown" option), but nothing in the pack shows an interactive explorer or runnable 'try it' examples. The OpenAPI/Swagger probe returned 404 on every candidate path. The live demo sites are end-user search showcases, not an API reference, so the interactive, runnable part of the story is unevidenced.
